scenarios.context: A severe famine has struck Canaan. Word arrives that Egypt has grain, but the journey is treacherous.
scenarios.prompt: As a tribal leader, what is your executive order?

options.text: Risk the journey to Egypt to secure grain.

outcomes.text: You secured grain, but at a heavy cost. You are now a resident alien in Egypt.
The border guards seized your wealth. You are enslaved.
You traded brilliantly. You arrive in Egypt as a wealthy merchant.

options.text: Ration our remaining food and trust God for rain in Canaan.

outcomes.text: The rains eventually come, but your family suffered greatly.
The drought persists. You lose half your livestock to starvation.

scenarios.context: Your clan stands before the fortified walls of Jericho at flood stage along the Jordan.
scenarios.prompt: How do you command the vanguard across the threshold of the Promised Land?

options.text: Follow the Ark of the Covenant in silent seven-day obedience.

outcomes.text: On the seventh day the trumpet blast shatters the ramparts without a siege ramp.
The walls fall, though scavengers in the camp trigger an internal discipline crisis.

options.text: Dispatch covert scouts to negotiate safe passage with Rahab's household.

outcomes.text: Intelligence gathered behind the walls secures a bloodline alliance that endures for generations.
Pursuers close the city gates; your scouts barely escape through the hill country.

scenarios.context: Two petitioners bring a bitter royal dispute before your judgment seat in Jerusalem with no external witnesses.
scenarios.prompt: What ruling do you issue from the throne?

options.text: Test both hearts with a piercing discernment trial that exposes true devotion.

outcomes.text: All Israel hears of the judgment and reveres the wisdom of God within your house.
Justice prevails, though rival court factions murmur against your severity.

options.text: Defer judgment until scribes audit the temple treasury ledgers.

outcomes.text: The audit uncovers hidden debt and stabilizes royal taxation.
Delays embolden false witnesses across the gate.

scenarios.context: Drought grips the northern kingdom. Four hundred fifty prophets of Baal assemble on Mount Carmel.
scenarios.prompt: How do you confront the divided nation on the mountain?

options.text: Repair the broken altar of the Lord, drench the wood in water, and call down fire from heaven.

outcomes.text: Fire consumes the sacrifice, stones, and water—turning the hearts of the people back.
The altar blazes, but royal retaliation forces you into a wilderness refuge.

options.text: Preserve a hidden remnant of faithful prophets in mountain caves.

outcomes.text: Seven thousand who have not bowed the knee survive to rebuild the nation.
Supply lines run thin, testing the endurance of the faithful.

scenarios.context: A furious squall strikes the Sea of Galilee at night while crossing toward Decapolis.
scenarios.prompt: Waves swamp the vessel—how do you respond in the storm?

options.text: Stand firm in faith and trust the Master's authority over wind and wave.

outcomes.text: At a single word—'Peace, be still'—a great calm settles over the deep.
The gale subsides, leaving the crew humbled by their own hesitation.

options.text: Man the oars and bail water until daybreak.

outcomes.text: Exhausted at dawn, you witness deliverance on the shoreline.
The rudder snaps in the gale, forcing complete reliance on providence.

scenarios.context: Elders and apostles convene in Jerusalem to decide how Gentile believers enter the fellowship of the early church.
scenarios.prompt: What apostolic decree do you send to the assemblies across the Mediterranean?

options.text: Affirm salvation by grace through faith without burdening the nations with yoke-laws.

outcomes.text: The churches rejoice at the encouragement, multiplying rapidly across Antioch and Rome.
Unity holds in Jerusalem, though faction agitators trail your missionary journeys.

options.text: Dispatch trusted couriers with sealed epistles to strengthen every local assembly.

outcomes.text: The circular letters establish unshakable doctrinal foundations across the empire.
Shipwreck delays delivery, yet prisoners and islanders hear the message along the way.
